decisions: Treat the invocation-time working tree, including the user's eleven pre-existing tracked modifications, as the protected UI baseline.
Record Phase 0's pre-existing build, typecheck, and lint failures without modifying product code, as explicitly allowed by the Phase 0 acceptance criteria.
Use the existing image.png as a preserved repository reference and headless Chrome captures as objective current-render evidence.
Keep Next.js App Router/Vercel route handlers as the backend boundary and use reproducible Supabase migrations/RLS rather than adding a standalone server.
Reserve the Supabase service-role client for verified server-only webhook/admin work; normal reads and writes remain session-scoped under RLS.
Disable email auto-publishing for MVP regardless of confidence; all extracted records begin in pending_review.
Use Supabase SSR cookie sessions and server getUser verification; remove the legacy local-storage JWT/OTP endpoints rather than leaving a parallel authentication path.
Use only Google OAuth and Supabase emailed magic links on the sign-in UI; remove phone and manual OTP entry, and support both PKCE-code and token-hash email callbacks before redirecting to /home.
Use the Supabase cloud free tier only: do not start local Docker services or add CI; validate migrations non-destructively until the intended cloud project is explicitly linked.

User override for AI publication: relevant verified-sender items may auto-publish when confidence is missing or meets threshold; unsupported categories normalize to other. Ambiguous dates, low present confidence, unverified senders, and irrelevant content remain review/rejected safeguards.
Pin Next.js and eslint-config-next to 15.5.23 after Vercel blocked the vulnerable 15.1.7 deployment; do not use the dangerous vulnerable-deployment bypass.

Use LeviClub as the visible product brand; keep the existing Luma-derived layout as the UI baseline, render the wordmark without a new image asset, and temporarily route every landing-footer link to the same-site root.
Use existing event cover_image_url values for Discover/category imagery without downloading files; use the configured server-side Cloudinary integration only for authenticated profile avatar uploads.

Keep only implemented, requirement-backed Settings surfaces: profile, authenticated primary email, display, and notifications. Remove demo payment and unsupported account-management surfaces with their corresponding code.
